    Duality #

    Remark 2.6 of the manuscript: (T, F) is a pretorsion theory in C iff (Fᵒᵖ, Tᵒᵖ) is a pretorsion theory in Cᵒᵖ, and this reverses the order (2.2). A length function on C is one on Cᵒᵖ. This is used to obtain the join formula (3.3) from the meet formula (3.2).
